risk_note: RV2 (funds path, no money moves). executeBatch now sets batch_id on a member it leaves when that member was on no batch (FU-BATCH-LEFT-MEMBERSHIP, BR-WDR-11, BR-WDR-12; D10-602, D10-609): member_blocked, has_transfer_attempt, channel_disabled, and a watermark reason on a batch of several channels. A later batch then moves it and this one records moved_out. not_approved never joins, one already on another batch with a watermark reason is not moved, and a whole-batch rejection still writes nothing, for automatic and manual batches alike. Amounts, status and the number of transfers do not change. Frozen expectations changed per D10-327, listed in the ledger and accepted under #24 at 12:56: AC-B2-09l #13, 15, 16, 23, 24, 27, 31 and four mixed-channel cases of AC-B2-06c#3, only batch_id, row_version and updated_at. The E-28 example in 08 is rewritten by the orchestrator. Known: a reject that read row_version 1 before a concurrent EXECUTE left the withdrawal now answers 20902 and succeeds on retry; before this change that race did not touch row_version.

One out-of-scope S2 on the reject race, reported to the orchestrator.
